scope: 50 distinct selected method depictions; not a fresh review of their entire papers or a canonical method census
test_selection_reason: Readout carrier versus target; sample versus capture reagent and independent DNA/RNA branches; molecular end-group change and coupled reaction. Old results are baselines only, never author evidence.
evaluation_questions: Can a query distinguish material/data identity, molecular features, organization and attribution without parsing a miscellaneous feature paragraph?
Can a query distinguish processed sample, supplied material and readout inputs for each Operation, including mixed-role reagents?
Does each Operation explicitly explain its effect on its declared inputs/outputs while preserving the source grouping?
Do output properties have source support without claiming absent, unchanged or not-applicable properties merely because the source is silent?
Are independent branches and jointly processed mixtures distinguishable without inferring molecular lineage from graph reachability?
